findings.issue: Pervasive `data: any` / `as any` typing across all dynamic pages discards Astro's TypeScript checking on the data every template depends on
findings.suggestion: Define light interfaces for the PokeAPI responses (species, move, ability, type) and the derived page data in a types file

findings.issue: Re-implements pokemonRefsToSpecies (data.js:61-77) to capture is_hidden, producing two near-identical fan-out-and-dedupe blocks
findings.suggestion: Extend pokemonRefsToSpecies to return the source entry (or a mapper callback) so both pages share one implementation

findings.issue: Identical 404 try/catch block copy-pasted in four dynamic pages
findings.suggestion: Extract a `loadOrNotFound(fn)` helper into lib/api.js or data.js

findings.issue: ~150 lines of data shaping inline in the page frontmatter make the heaviest file harder to follow
findings.suggestion: Move the shaping into a lib function (e.g. getPokemonPage(name)) so the page reads like the others

findings.issue: Client scripts live in /public and are loaded with is:inline, bypassing Astro's bundled, TypeScript-checked script handling (same in pokemon/[name].astro:311)
findings.suggestion: Move them to processed <script> tags (or colocated files) so Astro bundles, minifies and type-checks them

findings.issue: No timeout or AbortController on upstream fetches; a hung API call hangs the request indefinitely
Failed/partial results fetch is silently ignored, leaving stale results with no user feedback
findings.suggestion: Show a lightweight inline error or retry affordance on failure

findings.issue: pushState on every debounced keystroke floods history with intermediate search states; back button then replays each state via reload
findings.suggestion: Use replaceState while typing and pushState on filter changes

findings.issue: First-entry-wins dedupe can mislabel the 'Hidden ability' text when a Pokémon lists the same ability as both normal and hidden
findings.suggestion: Track hidden separately (hidden = hidden || entry.is_hidden) during dedupe

findings.issue: Astro 7's stable route caching is unused; heavy, cacheable pages like /pokemon/:name re-render per request against a snapshot API
findings.suggestion: Consider cache: memoryCache() plus routeRules maxAge for detail routes (mind the spec's live-data requirement)

summary: A well-executed, current-version Astro 7 SSR app: idiomatic config, standard data-loading patterns, careful race/fan-out/404 handling, and a clean module structure. The main debts are untyped page data, a couple of copy-pasted helpers, and client JS kept outside Astro's script pipeline. I'd approve after a round of nits — nothing structural blocks merge.
